title: Grateful Dead Live at Uptown Theater on 1981-02-26
source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Technics Reel To Reel > Panasonic SV-3800 Dat 16/44

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard capture of an Uptown Chicago show, with a notably stronger second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording’s fidelity – calling it “stellar” and as good as any from that era, despite minor equipment quirks. The performance is described as a solid first set followed by a much better second set, making the overall concert enjoyable. No specific song or player critiques were offered.

ai_rating.rationale: Excellent recording quality (soundboard, high fidelity) combined with a good show that improves in the second set; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear fidelity for the era, praised as “stellar”; minor equipment issues noted but not detrimental.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Decent first set with a noticeably stronger second set, according to reviewers.
